conviction_note: The FY2026 guide was raised by inside-information announcement on 2026-10-08 (revenue ~DKK 6,100m, EBITDA margin ~32%), five weeks before this nine-month report, so the main line is pre-released and unlikely to move again; what is left is small positives (a likely next buyback tranche, a new UK contract) against a new CEO's first report, so p_up sits at 52 on an abs move of 4.0 and the findings sum (+0.3) and the scaled number (+0.16) agree in sign and are both near zero.

already_public.what: FY2026 guidance raised to revenue ~DKK 6,100m (Travel Health ~3,400m, Public Preparedness ~2,500m of which ~2,400m secured, other 200m), EBITDA margin ~32% (company announcement no. 48, inside information)
H1 2026: revenue DKK 3,092m, EBITDA DKK 1,090m (35%); Q2 revenue 2,034m, EBITDA margin 45%; guidance raised to ~5,700m / ~30%; ~DKK 800m PP revenue secured for 2027; up to DKK 750m buyback announced
First buyback tranche completed: 1,105,446 shares for ~DKK 250m since 2026-09-01; treasury holding 4,664,037 shares (5.88%)
New four-year UKHSA contract for MVA-BN, value undisclosed, issued as a press release rather than inside information
Tarja Stenvall appointed CEO (took office 2026-10-15); this is her first report

new_in_release.expect: Q3 revenue and EBITDA are new, but implied by the 10-08 guide (FY ~6,100 less H1 3,092 leaves ~3,008 for H2); a Q3/Q4 phasing surprise is possible in either direction, and there is no sourced Q3 consensus
most likely reiterated at ~6,100 / ~32% five weeks after the raise; a small upside nudge is possible if rabies demand kept going, but nothing points to it
likely launch of a further tranche of the up-to-DKK 750m programme (DKK ~500m remaining); modestly positive and partly expected
2027 Public Preparedness visibility (orders secured for 2027, last ~DKK 800m in August) and the new CEO's first framing; the sign is unknown and this is the most likely source of a larger move

findings.finding: The FY2026 guide was raised for the third time on 2026-10-08 to revenue ~DKK 6,100m / EBITDA margin ~32%, so the release's main line is pre-released and a fourth move is unlikely; at most a confirmation, with H2 implied at ~DKK 3,008m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock rose from 223.2 to 241.2 DKK over 10-08 to 10-12 on the upgrade (Yahoo closes), then peaked at 256.2 on 10-27 and drifted back to 240.2. The H1 report with a guide raise moved +9.06% (2026-08-21, per the baseline's estimated history). Q3 2024 fell about 12% on an mpox sales and orders miss (https://www.pharmaceutical-technology.com/news/bavarian-nordic-shares-sink-by-12-after-mpox-sales-slump-in-q3/).
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the stock rerated about 8% in the three sessions after the announcement. The only unpriced part is whether management nudges the range again, which nothing supports, so this sits near 0.
findings.independence: AL Sydbank (Søren Løntoft Hansen) called the October upgrade 'større end ventet' (bigger than expected), via https://aktietip.dk/bavarian-nordic-aktie-fire-opjusteringer-og-en-ny-topchef-i-2026/

findings.finding: The first tranche (~DKK 250m) of the up-to-DKK 750m buyback finished on 2026-11-02, leaving ~DKK 500m (~2.6% of a ~DKK 19bn market cap) unlaunched. The company has launched tranches alongside reports before (2026-03-12 with the annual report), so a new tranche with the Q3 report is likely.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The buyback was announced alongside the guide raise on 2026-08-21 (+9.06% that day, not separable). The tranche launch on 2026-03-12 came with the annual report, whose estimated-window move was -3.55% (2026-03-03 estimate), so no clean read.
findings.why_not_priced: The programme size is public, so most of it is priced. Only the timing of the next tranche, and therefore buying flow from the report date, is not.

findings.finding: A new four-year UKHSA contract for MVA-BN with planned deliveries plus options was announced on 2026-11-02 as a press release, not inside information, with no value given. Its contribution to secured 2027+ Public Preparedness revenue may first be quantified in the Q3 report.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Close +2.4% on 2026-11-02 (245.4 to 251.2) and -2.7% the next day (244.4). Earlier contract news (2026-06-09, 2026-05-11) went out as inside information and was folded into later guide raises.
findings.original_quote: I henhold til den fireårige kontrakt skal Bavarian Nordic levere MVA-BN gennem planlagte leverancer i kontraktperioden. Kontrakten indeholder desuden optioner, der kan udnyttes af den britiske regering efter behov. (Under the four-year contract Bavarian Nordic will supply MVA-BN through planned deliveries over the contract period. The contract also contains options the UK government can exercise as needed.)
findings.why_not_priced: The value is undisclosed and it was not classed as inside information, so the market cannot price its size. The next-day reversal suggests it was read as small. If a 2027 secured-revenue figure above the August ~DKK 800m appears, that number would be new.

findings.finding: This is the first report under CEO Tarja Stenvall (in office since 2026-10-15). The 2026 PP base (~DKK 2,500m) is far above the ~DKK 800m secured for 2027 as of August, so first remarks on 2027 visibility can move the stock either way. This is an inference, with a slight negative lean from a possible reset of expectations.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior CEO-transition print. Paul Chaplin's departure announcement (2026-03-02) fell in the estimated window that moved -3.55% around 2026-03-03.
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody can price commentary that has not been given. If the market expected a reset, the stock would not sit within 7% of its 52-week high (257.0) with a 60-day run-up of +25%. Because it does, a cautious 2027 framing would land on a priced-for-growth stock.
findings.independence: The ~DKK 800m secured for 2027 is from the H1 report: https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=be85b77363f51d7d190e5b282e8e44040&lang=en&src=listed

baseline_tension: Mild agreement with the +1.56 priced lean (light covering short) and the flat 20-day run-up. Nothing cuts against it strongly, but the guide is pre-released, so the lean has little new information to work with.

'Move is in the guide; reiterated 2.3% vs pre-released 3.1%': abs_move_pct cut from 4.5 to 4.0, kept above the 3% base because the Q3 numbers themselves are new, there is a CEO change, and the name fell 12% on Q3 2024.
